description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: tall cracked ice pillar, cluster of ice stalagmites, glowing blue Haven crystal vein in a rock, stone wall slab with a carved coiled eastern dragon relief, small eastern stone lantern coated in frost, frozen waterfall chunk, bear den bed of straw and old bones, small snow grave mound with a tiny knitted mitten on top and a ring of ice candles, rusty brass machine stake wrapped in glowing red threads and frost, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
